# SlimefunAdvancements 1.0.1

## Dynamic Recipe Registration Fix

This release fixes a compatibility issue where Slimefun Advancements could trigger a global Bukkit data reload while Slimefun and its addons were already running. On modern Paper servers, that reload can rebuild datapack/recipe state and cause dynamically registered recipes to disappear.

### What changed

- Prevented Slimefun Advancements from calling `Bukkit.reloadData()` when its vanilla advancements are removed and rebuilt.
- Existing installs with `reload-data-on-adv-remove: true` are automatically migrated to the safe value of `false`.
- The safe setting is also enforced after `/sfadvancements reload` so an older config cannot accidentally re-enable the behavior.
- Removed the obsolete bundled AdvancementAPI dependency. Its legacy advancement creation code contained global data reload and recipe snapshot/restore logic that is no longer required by this fork.
- Vanilla Minecraft advancement integration remains available with `use-advancements-api: true`.
- Version bumped to `1.0.1`.

### Why this matters

Slimefun Legacy and many Slimefun addons register recipes dynamically at runtime. A global Bukkit data reload after those registrations can invalidate or remove that recipe state. Slimefun Advancements now manages its own advancement registrations without forcing a server-wide data reload.

### Updating

Replace the previous SlimefunAdvancements JAR with `SF_SlimefunAdvancements1.0.1.jar` and perform a full server restart.

Do not use `/reload` as a substitute for the restart when testing this fix.

### Recommended verification

After restarting, confirm that recipes which previously disappeared after Slimefun Advancements initialized are still present and usable. Vanilla Slimefun advancement tabs should continue to function normally when `use-advancements-api` is enabled.
